name: Farmer's Delight
summary: Farming, cooking and food: crops, cutting board, cooking pot, skillet, stove and feasts.
description: A cozy farming and cooking mod built around a short farm-to-table loop and a few small stations.

agent.one_liner: Grow, cut and cook food through a small set of stations with hidden heat, progress and slot roles.
good_at: meals and feasts with clear inputs
not_good_at: operating the pot through generic container slots
seeing heat, progress or slot roles without an integration
planning a multi-dish menu without a recipe graph
examples: cut a log into a stripped log and bark, then cook a stew
plant rice, harvest it, and serve a meal
limitations: progress and heat live in block entities
recipe types are not in the vanilla recipe list
